## Names

<a id="show_falls_count"></a>
### [`show_falls_count`](../../../src/status_and_keys.asm#L10) `$1AED`

*routine*

Prints falls_left (falls/lives left of the current player, 0-99) as two decimal digits on the status line ("FALLS 04"), at game_screen offset $4A (row 1, column 34). Converts by repeated subtraction of 10: bcd_conv_digits counts the tens, bcd_conv_binary keeps the units; the packed BCD byte goes to print_hex_byte, which prints it as two digits (both nibbles are 0-9). Called at game start and whenever falls_left changes (fall lost, extra fall). Changes A, Y.

- **Called from:** [`reset_play_state`](play_init.md#reset_play_state) [`$0813`](../../../src/play_init.asm#L98), [`frame_update`](frame_update.md#frame_update) [`$1794`](../../../src/frame_update.asm#L341), [`$2FE7`](../../../src/touch_effects.asm#L21), [`add_pending_score`](score.md#add_pending_score) [`$3157`](../../../src/score.asm#L36)
- **Calls:** [`print_hex_byte`](status_and_keys.md#print_hex_byte)
- **Reads:** [`falls_left`](../memory-map.md#falls_left), [`bcd_conv_digits`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_digits), [`bcd_conv_binary`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_binary)
- **Writes:** [`bcd_conv_digits`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_digits), [`bcd_conv_binary`](fireball_text_score_vars.md#bcd_conv_binary)

<a id="print_bcd_byte"></a>
### [`print_bcd_byte`](../../../src/status_and_keys.asm#L39) `$1B17`

*routine*

Prints the packed BCD byte in A as two digit characters at game_screen+Y (tens) and game_screen+1+Y (units). The digit characters of the game font are $10-$19, so each nibble is ORed with $10. Used by the score display (1UP score and TOP score, three BCD bytes each). Changes A.

- **Called from:** [`show_score`](score.md#show_score) [`$3162`](../../../src/score.asm#L43), [`show_score`](score.md#show_score) [`$316A`](../../../src/score.asm#L46), [`show_score`](score.md#show_score) [`$3172`](../../../src/score.asm#L49), [`show_high_score`](score.md#show_high_score) [`$31F9`](../../../src/score.asm#L141), [`show_high_score`](score.md#show_high_score) [`$3201`](../../../src/score.asm#L144), [`show_high_score`](score.md#show_high_score) [`$3209`](../../../src/score.asm#L147)
- **Calls:** [`get_high_nibble`](score.md#get_high_nibble)
- **Refers to:** [`game_screen`](../memory-map.md#game_screen), [`game_screen+1`](../memory-map.md#game_screen)

<a id="handle_game_keys"></a>
### [`handle_game_keys`](../../../src/status_and_keys.asm#L57) `$1B29`

*routine*

In-game key handler. The main loop calls it once per pass in a real game (game_mode = 1), not in the attract demo. Sets key_scan_mode (only F1, S, SPACE and V are decoded), runs scan_keyboard, and acts on a new key (key_ready = 1), which it acknowledges: F1 ($04)    restart_to_title (does not return) S ($0D)     toggle title_music_off (the title tune on/off) and clear title_music_skip_count SPACE ($3C) toggle_pause (does not return here) V ($1F)     toggle_credit_line (credit text in screen row 0) The key code without the shift bit is also stored in last_game_key (nothing reads it).

- **Called from:** [`main_loop`](game_main_loop.md#main_loop) [`$1BCE`](../../../src/game_main_loop.asm#L29)
- **Calls:** [`scan_keyboard`](keyboard_scan.md#scan_keyboard)
- **Jumps to:** [`restart_to_title`](title_demo_start.md#restart_to_title), [`toggle_pause`](pause_status_line.md#toggle_pause)
- **Reads:** [`key_ready`](../memory-map.md#key_ready), [`key_code`](../memory-map.md#key_code), [`title_music_off`](room_enemy_tables.md#title_music_off), [`game_screen`](../memory-map.md#game_screen), [`version_banner+38`](messages_rooms.md#version_banner), [`version_banner+39`](messages_rooms.md#version_banner)
- **Writes:** [`key_scan_mode`](../memory-map.md#key_scan_mode), [`key_ready`](../memory-map.md#key_ready), [`last_game_key`](../memory-map.md#last_game_key), [`title_music_off`](room_enemy_tables.md#title_music_off), [`title_music_skip_count`](title_menu.md#title_music_skip_count), [`game_screen+38`](../memory-map.md#game_screen), [`game_screen+39`](../memory-map.md#game_screen)

<a id="print_hex_byte"></a>
### [`print_hex_byte`](../../../src/status_and_keys.asm#L116) `$1B84`

*routine*

Prints A as two hexadecimal digit characters at game_screen+Y and game_screen+1+Y. Nibbles 0-9 become characters $10-$19; nibbles A-F become $21-$26 (the letters A-F of the font). show_falls_count passes a packed decimal value, so the letter case never occurs there; the unused debug_show_values passes real hexadecimal values. Changes A.

- **Called from:** [`show_falls_count`](status_and_keys.md#show_falls_count) [`$1B14`](../../../src/status_and_keys.asm#L35)
- **Calls:** [`get_high_nibble`](score.md#get_high_nibble)
- **Refers to:** [`game_screen`](../memory-map.md#game_screen), [`game_screen+1`](../memory-map.md#game_screen)
